Interface IEvent

All Superinterfaces:
IEntity
public interface IEvent extends IEntity
Represents a social event that can be attended by students.

      void setTitle(String title)

    • setDescription

    • setDateTime

      void setDateTime(LocalDateTime startDateTime, LocalDateTime endDateTime)
      Sets the start and end date/time for this event.

      An event can only be assigned a date and time once it has been given a location.

      Parameters:
      startDateTime - when the event begins; must not be null
      endDateTime - when the event ends; must not be null and must be after startDateTime
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no location has been assigned to the event.

    • setLocation

      void setLocation(String location)
      Sets the location of this event.
      Parameters:
      location - the venue or address where the event takes place
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if trying to remove the location when the event has already been assigned a date and time.

    • setCapacity

      void setCapacity(Integer capacity)
      Sets the maximum number of attendees for this event.
      Parameters:
      capacity - the attendee cap, or null for an unlimited event
